title: Walk and Talk
body:
Goal: make a sprite walk across the stage and talk, in the right order. Time: about 10 minutes. Tool: Scratch app (offline).

Build steps

  1. Open the Scratch app. Click Choose a Backdrop and pick any place.
  2. Build the script below for the cat (or any sprite). glide is in Motion.
  3. Click the green flag and watch.
  4. Save: File > Save to your computer, name walk-and-talk.

The script in words

  • when green flag clicked
  • go to x: -180 y: -100
  • say "Hi! I am Pixel Panda" for 2 seconds (use your own nickname)
  • glide 2 secs to x: 0 y: -100
  • say "Look at this place!" for 2 seconds
  • glide 2 secs to x: 180 y: -100
  • say "Bye!" for 2 seconds

Creative extra: add switch backdrop to ... (in Looks) between the glides so your sprite walks into a new place each time.

Expected behavior

When you click the green flag, the sprite starts on the left, says hello, glides to the middle, talks, glides to the right and says "Bye!". It starts on the left again every time you click the flag.

Checklist

hints.label: Hint 1
hints.title: Where to look
hints.html: Read the goal and the steps in words. The sprite starts on the left, moves to the middle, then moves to the right. It talks at the start, in the middle and at the end.

hints.label: Hint 2
hints.title: Try this
hints.html: Under when green flag clicked, use go to x: ( ) y: ( ) from Motion to place your sprite on the left. Use glide ( ) secs to x: ( ) y: ( ), also from Motion, for each walk. Use say ( ) for ( ) seconds from Looks for each talk.

hints.label: Hint 3
hints.title: Almost there
hints.html: Talking and walking take turns, so they alternate in your stack. Each glide block moves the sprite to a new spot, and only the x number changes if you want to stay at the same height. Left is a negative x, and right is a positive x.
